title: Ctrl V Virtual Reality
gap: Duration not stated for VR Escape Room and Educational VR
blurb: Guests experience high-end PC VR with over 100 titles including multiplayer, puzzle, horror, sports, and creative tools. The venue offers private groups with no shared headsets and staff guidance for beginners. Sessions include 30-minute short sessions, 1-hour standard sessions, and VR escape rooms, plus birthday parties and corporate team building.
